posts.title: Sorry About that Last One
posts.description: Apologies for yesterday's posting (which I've retracted). It was incoherent, as if I'd written it a little drunk. But I was stone cold sober, and worked hard on it. The ideas were sound, but I failed to tie them together. Since it all worked cleanly in my head , I let it out into the world like that. This is alarming, because the job of a writer is to write to be read, i.e. to make it make sense.

posts.title: The Rip-Off
posts.description: I'd planned to spend my first months in Portugal renting a room from two of my dearest, oldest friends, but they turned out to be late-stage alcoholics who flipped between two modes: 1. posts.title: God Helps Those Who Help Themselves
posts.description: I have eaten in tens of thousands of restaurants and been a regular in hundreds of them. I've seen restaurant lifecycles unfold in every context, and the toughest chunk is the long slog of disinterest when a good place can't attract enough customers to keep the lights on.
